subject: Sink not writing to the output file

messages.author: 7768d5f581411dd3
messages.subject: Sink not writing to the output file
parts:
Hi

I am a new user of Renjin. 
I am building an engine which will let the user run R scripts over my platform which is coded in java.

I have the task to write the console output to a file which could be returned back to the user.

This is the snippet of my code


con <- file(open="rOutputTest.txt");

sink("rOutputTest.txt"); 

df <- data.frame(x=1:5, y=(1:5)+rnorm(n=5)); 

print(df); 

print(lm(y ~ x, df));



This created an file in the current directory with name "rOutputTest.txt" which is unfortunately empty. When I run the same sequence of commands on the R-Console, it works like a charm.


If I add  "readLines("rOutputTest.txt");" at the end, it returns "\ufffd\ufffd" back to my java code.

capture.output fails with this error message "org.renjin.eval.EvalException: Sorry! withVisible not yet implemented!"



Any pointers.



Thanks


Akshat Bakliwal

messages.author: f06db63329fab1f9
messages.subject: Re: Sink not writing to the output file
parts:
Hi Akshat,

I've opened Issues #98 and #99 for missing library functions sink() and withVisible()

https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/98
https://github.com/bedatadriven/renjin/issues/99

withVisible() should be pretty trivial to implement [see the implementation of invisible()] and sink() should be made easier by recent improvements to the i/o implementation.

Pull requests welcome!

Alex
